p1.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/final-cac-question-responses-9-19-25-redacted-c-1.pdf
p1.excerpt: We have already launched MWBE capacity-building efforts, including two contracting sessions at Citi Field, a $25 million lending program to expand capital access, and robust prequalification processes.

p2.title: https://gaming.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/12/hrmp-license-document-executed-12.22.25-c.pdf
p2.excerpt: On December 15, 2025, the New York State Gaming Commission having determined that Queens Future, LLC doing business as Hard Rock Metropolitan Park (herein “Hard Rock”), is suitable and not disqualified for licensure pursuant to New York Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law

p3.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/final-cac-question-responses-9-19-25-redacted-c-1.pdf
p3.excerpt: As a majority-minority owned joint venture, HRMP takes our MWBE goals and commitments seriously and is fully aligned with our community partners goals. We anticipate utilizing centralized data tracking for MWBE utilization in all respects. Our equity partner McKissack will oversee maintenance of data tracking in order for HRMP to meet all of our commitments. We expressly pledged to Borough President Richards, as part of his review of our previous land use action, that we would provide quarterly reporting on local hiring and MWBE utilization, and hold quarterly meetings with all local elected officials to provide them updates on MWBE and local hiring goals.

p4.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/final-cac-responses-9.29.25-1-c.pdf
p4.excerpt: Yes. Hard Rock Metropolitan Park (“HRMP”) will proudly host a minimum of five MWBE vendor and procurement fairs at Citi Field over the next year, creating direct access for minority- and women-owned businesses to contracting opportunities.

p5.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/final-cac-responses-9.29.25-1-c.pdf
p5.excerpt: We also provide technical assistance to help businesses gain MWBE certification and are backing this work with a $25 million MWBE lending program.

decisions.label: ENTAILMENT
decisions.reason: p5 states HRMP is "backing this work with a $25 million MWBE lending program," which establishes a $25 million pledge/commitment for the lending program.

decisions.label: ENTAILMENT
decisions.reason: p1 describes the program as expanding capital access within MWBE capacity-building efforts, and p5 expressly calls it a "$25 million MWBE lending program," identifying MWBE firms as beneficiaries.

decisions.label: NEUTRAL
decisions.reason: p3 says McKissack is an equity partner overseeing MWBE data tracking, but it does not tie McKissack to the lending proposal specifically or show the Board highlighted that partnership alongside it.
